title: Zephyr: Rule 2 decompression
description: Implement Rule 2 decompression in Zephyr C. Acceptance: decompresses to original headers, cross-validates.
notes: Implemented current-spec Zephyr wire Rule 2 decompression for canonical link-local IPv6 + ICMPv6 Echo Request/Reply; stale parent IPv6/UDP wording does not control. Decoder now enforces the 22554-byte encoded ceiling, rejects every truncated 22-byte residue, all 254 non-Echo discriminator values, unknown rules, and undersized output atomically, parses the exact byte-aligned 176-bit residue, preserves every following Echo payload octet, and reconstructs IPv6/ICMPv6 lengths/code/checksum. Exhaustively tested all 256 first payload octets; Rule 2 has no padding bits. Validation: sanitizer-backed focused C PASS 1/1; Rule 2 compression plus Rules 3/4/7 regressions PASS 6/6; Python Rule 2 PASS 566; Rust canonical/header tests PASS 2; cppcheck PASS.
close_reason: Implemented and cross-validated atomic current-spec Zephyr SCHC Rule 2 decompression
